info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Intellectual Property Portfolio Retrieval API
info.description: The Intellectual Property Portfolio Retrieval API provides users with access to detailed information about an organization's intellectual property assets. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve specific data regarding patents, trademarks, and copyrights, facilitating informed decision-making in asset management and strategy. Common users include legal teams, innovation managers, and business analysts looking to gain insights into the intellectual property landscape. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can efficiently assess the value and status of their IP portfolio.

get.summary: Retrieve Intellectual Property Portfolio by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information about a specific intellectual property portfolio, identified by its unique ID. The returned data includes all relevant attributes and metadata pertaining to the portfolio, enabling users to make informed decisions based on the ip's content and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about a specific intellectual property asset within the portfolio. The expected input is a JSON object containing the necessary parameters for the query. Ensure that you provide all required fields to get accurate results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested intellectual property portfolio.

GetIntellectualPropertyPortfolioByIdRequ.title: Intellectual Property Portfolio Request Body

GetIntellectualPropertyPortfolioByIdResp.title: Intellectual Property Portfolio Response

ipAssetId.description: Unique identifier for the intellectual property asset.

ownerLegalEntityId.description: Identifier for the legal entity that owns the asset.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the asset record.
